date.as_written: iṣurāmamuniī(!)nduś ca śākeḥ(!) vyoma-adrināga-ī(!)nduś ca samvat || māse mṛge tithau rāmanakṣatre vedanetrayayo- ge ca vasu ī(!)ndavaḥ pakṣe ca sasināmasya (!) vāre ca netrakas tathā karaṇe ca vedakas tathā

notes: Both Śāka (iṣu-rāma-muni-indu = 1735) and Vikrama Saṃvat (vyoma-adri-nāga-indu = 1870) years are stated chronogrammatically, corresponding to 1813 CE. Sallyānā near the Dudh Koshi river likely refers to Salyan in eastern Nepal (Solu/Okhaldhunga region).
